packageRules.description: These test pins follow the Kotlin version detekt is built against, not the project's. See the comment in the file.
The -0.6.x-compat builds keep the old 0.6 API for libraries that still need it. Renovate reads the suffix as newer than the plain release.
The build compiles on the toolchain and daemon JDK set in build-logic and gradle-daemon-jvm.properties, whatever setup-java installs. Change all of them together, by hand.
